pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 WORD CLASSES: VERB ASPECT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we show the time if an action has just taken place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the present and past perfect aspect in varied texts for effective communication
2. use the present perfect and past perfect aspect correctly in sentences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect

Teach
• Focus skill: identify the present and past perfect aspect in varied texts for effective communication.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we show the time if an action has just taken place?
2. How do we show that an action has been completed?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
